hero.title: Quality, design, and technology in perfect balance.
hero.subtitle: Highlighting electrical installations, network infrastructure, home automation, and audio/video systems.

home.whoWeAreDesc: We have 15 years of experience (installations in the UK, automation, AV installations). We take a comprehensive approach to security, offering systems from brands like Jablotron, Paradox, and Risco, access control systems such as Salto, and camera and access solutions from Ubiquiti. This allows us to provide tailor-made security solutions using flexible and proven technologies.

whatWeDo.desc1: We offer Crestron, Loxone, and Lutron. Crestron is highly customizable, while Loxone is cost-effective—providing tailor-made solutions for every client.
whatWeDo.desc2: Installation of Hi-Fi equipment (Denon, Marantz, LG, Sonos, Bowers & Wilkins).
whatWeDo.desc3: Design and installation of metallic and optical networks (Ubiquiti, MikroTik, Cisco).
whatWeDo.desc4: Design and implementation of electrical installations, including switchboards and sockets.

security.title: Security
security.subtitle: Peace of mind for your home
security.desc: You can’t put a price on the peace of mind that comes with knowing your loved ones are safe and what’s most precious and treasured are secure whether you are at home or away.
security.desc1: Continuous system feedback on our mobile device confirms the status of door locks and alarms, the exact positions of gates and garages, and provides real-time views of cameras.

wellness.title: Wellness
wellness.subtitle: Yes. Your home can benefit your health
wellness.desc: Your sleep. Your energy. Your mood. Your emotional and physical health. A smart home can improve and support these, and other, aspects of wellness. Lighting, acoustics, temperature, and water quality all play a role. The Crestron Home® OS allows you to easily orchestrate your home’s environment, as well as how your home interacts with the outside world to create an oasis that enhances your life.

comfort.title: Comfort
comfort.subtitle: Your home is your sanctuary
comfort.desc: It’s the one place that is truly your own. Everything is impeccably suited to you.
comfort.desc1: The cushions are just as soft or firm as you like. The fixtures and finishes are carefully selected. The light and temperature in every space are always perfectly adjusted for every hour and every occasion.

convenience.title: Convenience
convenience.subtitle: Your home should work for you, not the other way around
convenience.desc: The Crestron Home® OS makes the complex simple: The monotonous automatic; the tedious quick. Whatever you want, wherever you are, it’s a tap. Everything simply works the way you want it to every time.
convenience.desc1: No hoping. No stressing: Watch content and play video games on any TV; Listen to your favorite streaming service or playlist throughout the house.
